ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters localized on the high-intensity white fields of the left and inner right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions are visible cutting through the high-intensity regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural degradation and jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe, characterized by non-uniform, high-amplitude indentations.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe morphological asymmetry between the trailing edges of the left and right lobes.
